planets.name: HAT-P-2 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-2 with a 5.63-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: HAT-P-2 b was found in 2007 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HAT-P-2. Its orbit and size follow Ment et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname MENT_ET_AL__2018): disc_year 2007, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 5.633477, pl_radj 1.157, pl_bmassj 9.02

quotes.title: HAT-P-2b
quotes.card: HAT-P-2b is an extrasolar planet detected by the HATNet Project in May 2007.
quotes.introduction: It orbits a class F star HAT-P-2,, located about 420 light-years away in the constellation Hercules.
